reason: I am tired of calling every technician all day, and this time I only pay if my boys actually use it, so the risk of another dead app is on the founder, not me. At 999 a month for my size of shop I will try the free month, but only after he sits in my office and tells me who can see my customer list.
objection: My customer list is my business. If this app has all my customers' numbers and AMC dates, what stops it from being sold or given to a bigger competitor, and who in your company can see it?
would_change_my_mind: If the founder cannot give me a clear written promise that my customer data is not shared or used by anyone else, I will not start.
